verses.sloka: अवधूय च ताम् बुद्धिम् बभूव अवस्थितः तदा ।जगाम च अपराम् चिन्ताम् सीताम् प्रति महा कपिः ॥५-११-१॥
verses.transliteration: avadhūya ca tām buddhim babhūva avasthitaḥ tadā ।jagāma ca aparām cintām sītām prati mahā kapiḥ ॥5-11-1॥

translations.english: The great vanara, having rejected his judgement, started thinking again.

verses.sloka: न रामेण वियुक्ता सा स्वप्तुम् अर्हति भामिनी ।न भोक्तुम् न अपि अलम्कर्तुम् न पानम् उपसेवितुम् ॥५-११-२॥
verses.transliteration: na rāmeṇa viyuktā sā svaptum arhati bhāminī ।na bhoktum na api alamkartum na pānam upasevitum ॥5-11-2॥

translations.english: 'Lovely Sita, being away from Rama, will not sleep, will not eat or drink or adorn herself. How can she approach any other man even if he is the king of gods for there is none equal to Rama even among gods'. Having thus decided, Hanuman strolled about the banquet hall.
translations.hindi: हनुमानजी श्रीरामचन्द्रजी की प्यारी सीता को न देख कर, भत्यन्त - चिन्तित हो विचारने लगे कि तिश्‍वय ही जानकोजी जीवित नहीं हे । क्योंकि मैंने उन्हें इतना ढढ़ा, तो भी उनके दर्शन मुझे न हुए

verses.sloka: न अन्यम् नरम् उपस्थातुम् सुराणाम् अपि च ईश्वरम् ।न हि राम समः कश्चिद् विद्यते त्रिदशेष्व् अपि ॥५-११-३॥
verses.transliteration: na anyam naram upasthātum surāṇām api ca īśvaram ।na hi rāma samaḥ kaścid vidyate tridaśeṣv api ॥5-11-3॥

translations.english: 'Lovely Sita, being away from Rama, will not sleep, will not eat or drink or adorn herself. How can she approach any other man even if he is the king of gods for there is none equal to Rama even among gods'. Having thus decided, Hanuman strolled about the banquet hall.
translations.hindi: जान पड़ता है, अपने पातिब्रतधर्म की रक्षा में तत्पर ग्रौर श्रेष्ठ पाति- बतधम पर श्रारूढ़ जानकी को, इस दुष्टात्मा रावण ने मार डाला

verses.sloka: अन्या इयम् इति निश्चित्य पान भूमौ चचार सः ।क्रीडितेन अपराः क्लान्ता गीतेन च तथा पराः ॥५-११-४॥
verses.transliteration: anyā iyam iti niścitya pāna bhūmau cacāra saḥ ।krīḍitena aparāḥ klāntā gītena ca tathā parāḥ ॥5-11-4॥

translations.english: Some women were fatigued after sporting, similarly some were exhausted after singing. Others were tired through dancing and some were worn out by continuous drinking.
translations.hindi: अथवां इन कुरूप, विकराल, बुरे रंग वाली, बड़े-बड़े मुखों वाली, दीर्षा- कार श्रौर भयंकर नयनों वाली रावण की स्त्रियों को देख, डर के मारे सीता स्वयं ही मर गई

verses.sloka: नृत्तेन च अपराः क्लान्ताः पान विप्रहताः तथा ।मुरजेषु म्Rदन्गेषु पीठिकासु च सम्स्थिताः ॥५-११-५॥
verses.transliteration: nṛttena ca aparāḥ klāntāḥ pāna viprahatāḥ tathā ।murajeṣu mRdangeṣu pīṭhikāsu ca samsthitāḥ ॥5-11-5॥

translations.english: Some women reclined on tabors, some on murajas, and some on drums and hassocks while some slept on excellent couches.
translations.hindi: हा! न तो मुझे सीता का कुछ पता लगा और न समुद्र लाँघने का फल ही मुझे प्राप्त हुआ । फिर वानरों के लिए, सुग्रीव का नियत किया हुआ श्रवधि-काल भी व्यतीत हो गया । अतः भ्रव लोट कर सुग्रीव के पास जाना भी नहीं बन पड़ता । क्योंकि वह बलवान वानरराज'बड़ा कड़ा दण्ड देने वाला है

verses.sloka: तथा आस्तरण मुख्य्येषु सम्विष्टाः च अपराः स्त्रियः ।अङ्गनानाम् सहस्रेण भूषितेन विभूषणैः ॥५-११-६॥
verses.transliteration: tathā āstaraṇa mukhyyeṣu samviṣṭāḥ ca aparāḥ striyaḥ ।aṅganānām sahasreṇa bhūṣitena vibhūṣaṇaiḥ ॥5-11-6॥

translations.english: The monkey leader saw thousands of beautiful women asleep after long dalliance. Some of them were adorned with ornaments, some were good at arguments and versed in the appreciation of songs, some were aware of the appropriate time and place and some were adept in right expressions.
translations.hindi: मैने रावण का सारा रनवास श्रौर उसकी स्त्रियों को रत्ती रत्ती देख डाला, पर वह सती सीता न देख पड़ी--अ्रतः मेरा सारा परिश्रम मिट्टी में मिल गया

verses.sloka: रूप सम्ल्लाप शीलेन युक्त गीत अर्थ भाषिणा ।देश काल अभियुक्तेन युक्त वाक्य अभिधायिना ॥५-११-७॥
verses.transliteration: rūpa samllāpa śīlena yukta gīta artha bhāṣiṇā ।deśa kāla abhiyuktena yukta vākya abhidhāyinā ॥5-11-7॥

translations.english: The monkey leader saw thousands of beautiful women asleep after long dalliance. Some of them were adorned with ornaments, some were good at arguments and versed in the appreciation of songs, some were aware of the appropriate time and place and some were adept in right expressions.
translations.hindi: जब में लोटकर जाऊंगा और वानर मुझसे पूछेंगे कि, तुमने लंका में पहुँच कर क्या किया सो हमसे कहो--तब में उनसे क्या कहूंगा

verses.sloka: रत अभिरत सम्सुप्तम् ददर्श हरि यूथपः ।तासाम् मध्ये महा बाहुः शुशुभे राक्षस ईश्वरः ॥५-११-८॥
verses.transliteration: rata abhirata samsuptam dadarśa hari yūthapaḥ ।tāsām madhye mahā bāhuḥ śuśubhe rākṣasa īśvaraḥ ॥5-11-8॥

translations.english: In the midst of these women the longarmed lord of demons shone like a (majestic) bull in a big cowshed.
translations.hindi: जानकी को देखे बिना में उनसे क्या कहूंगा । ग्रतः सुग्रीव की निश्‍चित) की हुई समय की अवधि तो बीत ही गई, सो मे तो अब श्रन्न-जल-त्याग यहीं अपने प्राण गंवा दू गा

verses.sloka: गोष्ठे महति मुख्यानाम् गवाम् मध्ये यथा वृषः ।स राक्षस इन्द्रः शुशुभे ताभिः परिवृतः स्वयम् ॥५-११-९॥
verses.transliteration: goṣṭhe mahati mukhyānām gavām madhye yathā vṛṣaḥ ।sa rākṣasa indraḥ śuśubhe tābhiḥ parivṛtaḥ svayam ॥5-11-9॥

translations.english: Surrounded by the women, the demon king shone like a proud elephant attended by many female elephants scattered in a dense forest.

verses.sloka: करेणुभिर् यथा अरण्यम् परिकीर्णो महा द्विपः ।सर्व कामैर् उपेताम् च पान भूमिम् महात्मनः ॥५-११-१०॥
verses.transliteration: kareṇubhir yathā araṇyam parikīrṇo mahā dvipaḥ ।sarva kāmair upetām ca pāna bhūmim mahātmanaḥ ॥5-11-10॥

translations.english: The tiger among vanaras saw at the great Ravana's palace a drinking place where everything one desires was provided.
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार हताश होकर भी पवननन्दन ने पुनः मन ही मन कहा कि, मुझे अभी हतोत्साह न होना चाहिए--क्योंकि ) उत्साह ही कार्यसिद्धि की कुंजी है, उत्साह ही परम सुख का देने वाला है और उत्साह ही मनुष्यों को | सदैव सब कामों में लगाने वाला हे

verses.sloka: ददर्श कपि शार्दूलः तस्य रक्षः पतेर् गृहे ।मृगाणाम् महिषाणाम् च वराहाणाम् च भागशः ॥५-११-११॥
verses.transliteration: dadarśa kapi śārdūlaḥ tasya rakṣaḥ pater gṛhe ।mṛgāṇām mahiṣāṇām ca varāhāṇām ca bhāgaśaḥ ॥5-11-11॥

translations.english: There at the drinking hall the meat of deer, buffaloes and boars portioned and placed.
translations.hindi: उत्साहपूर्वक जीव जो काम करते हे, उत्साह उनके उस काम को सिद्ध करता है । अतः में अब उत्साहपूर्वंक सीताजी को ढूंढने का प्रयत्न करता हु\

verses.sloka: तत्र न्यस्तानि माम्सानि पान भूमौ ददर्श सः ।रौक्मेषु च विशलेषु भाजनेष्व् अर्ध भक्षितान् ॥५-११-१२॥
verses.transliteration: tatra nyastāni māmsāni pāna bhūmau dadarśa saḥ ।raukmeṣu ca viśaleṣu bhājaneṣv ardha bhakṣitān ॥5-11-12॥

translations.english: The tiger among vanaras also saw there meat of peacocks and chicken placed in large golden vessels, some half eaten.

verses.sloka: ददर्श कपि शार्दूल मयूरान् कुक्कुटामः तथा ।वराह वार्ध्राणसकान् दधि सौवर्चल आयुतान् ॥५-११-१३॥
verses.transliteration: dadarśa kapi śārdūla mayūrān kukkuṭāmaḥ tathā ।varāha vārdhrāṇasakān dadhi sauvarcala āyutān ॥5-11-13॥

translations.english: Hanuman saw the meat of pigs and jungle fowls, deer, peacocks and bones marinated with yoghurt and special kinds of salt.

verses.sloka: शल्यान् म्Rग मयूरामः च हनूमान् अन्ववैक्षत ।कृकरान् विविधान् सिद्धामः चकोरान् अर्ध भक्षितान् ॥५-११-१४॥
verses.transliteration: śalyān mRga mayūrāmaḥ ca hanūmān anvavaikṣata ।kṛkarān vividhān siddhāmaḥ cakorān ardha bhakṣitān ॥5-11-14॥

translations.english: He saw several kinds of (nonvegetarian) food like cooked meat of fowls, ruddy geese, buffaloes, goats, fishes as well as food for licking. (Food is of four kinds 1) भक्ष्य which can be chewed 2) भोज्य ordinary solid, semisolid food which can be consumed 3) लेह्य food for licking 4) चोष्य liquid food (which can be sipped)).
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार मत में निश्‍चय कर हनुमानजी, फिर ढूढने.में प्रवृत्त हुए । वे तहखाने (तलघरों) मे, चौराहों के मण्डपों में तथा रहने के घरों से दूर संर सपाटे के लिए बने हुए घरों में, ऊपर-नीचे सर्वत्र ढूंढ़ते लगे । कभी तो वे ऊपर ` चढते, कभी नीचे उतरते, कभी खड़े हो जाते प्रौर कभी फिर चल पड़ते थे । कहीं किवाड़ों को खोलते श्रौर कहीं उन्हें बन्द कर देते" थे

verses.sloka: महिषान् एक शल्यामः च चागामः च कृत निष्ठितान् ।लेख्यम् उच्च अवचम् पेयम् भोज्यानि विविधानि च ॥५-११-१५॥
verses.transliteration: mahiṣān eka śalyāmaḥ ca cāgāmaḥ ca kṛta niṣṭhitān ।lekhyam ucca avacam peyam bhojyāni vividhāni ca ॥5-11-15॥

translations.english: He saw several kinds of (nonvegetarian) food like cooked meat of fowls, ruddy geese, buffaloes, goats, fishes as well as food for licking. (Food is of four kinds 1) भक्ष्य which can be chewed 2) भोज्य ordinary solid, semisolid food which can be consumed 3) लेह्य food for licking 4) चोष्य liquid food (which can be sipped)).

verses.sloka: तथा अम्ल लवण उत्तम्सैर् विविधै राग षाडवैः ।हार नूपुर केयूरैर् अपविद्धैर् महा धनैः ॥५-११-१६॥
verses.transliteration: tathā amla lavaṇa uttamsair vividhai rāga ṣāḍavaiḥ ।hāra nūpura keyūrair apaviddhair mahā dhanaiḥ ॥5-11-16॥

translations.english: The banquet hall looked splendid with food seasoned with salt and sour ingredients. There was ragashadavas (syrup made with grapes, pomegranates, different juices like half ripe mangoes and seasoned with ginger cardomom, butter etc). Heavy chains, anklets and shouldersstraps were thrown aside. (The people relaxed while eating and drinking and discarded heavy ornaments). Many glasses were found scattered or drinks spilt on the floor after use.Many fruits and flowers were kept.

verses.sloka: पान भाजन विक्षिप्तैः फलैः च विविधैर् अपि ।कृत पुष्प उपहारा भूर् अधिकम् पुष्यति श्रियम् ॥५-११-१७॥
verses.transliteration: pāna bhājana vikṣiptaiḥ phalaiḥ ca vividhair api ।kṛta puṣpa upahārā bhūr adhikam puṣyati śriyam ॥5-11-17॥

translations.english: The banquet hall looked splendid with food seasoned with salt and sour ingredients. There was ragashadavas (syrup made with grapes, pomegranates, different juices like half ripe mangoes and seasoned with ginger cardomom, butter etc). Heavy chains, anklets and shouldersstraps were thrown aside. (The people relaxed while eating and drinking and discarded heavy ornaments). Many glasses were found scattered or drinks spilt on the floor after use.Many fruits and flowers were kept.
translations.hindi: । १ जत्यगृहानू--चतुष्पथमण्डपान्‌ । (गो?) २ गृहातिगृहकान्‌--गृहानतीत्य दूरे स्वेरविहारार्थं निर्मितान्‌ गृद्दान्‌। (गो०) १३४ सुन्दरकाण्डे सुन्दरकाण्ड यहाँ तक कि, रावण के रनवास में चार म्रंगुल भी. जगह ऐसी न बच्ची जहाँ कपि न गए हों घ्रौर जो उन्होंने न देखी हो-

verses.sloka: तत्र तत्र च विन्यस्तैः सुश्लिष्टैः शयन आसनैः ।पान भूमिर् विना वह्निम् प्रदीप्ता इव उपलक्ष्यते ॥५-११-१८॥
verses.transliteration: tatra tatra ca vinyastaiḥ suśliṣṭaiḥ śayana āsanaiḥ ।pāna bhūmir vinā vahnim pradīptā iva upalakṣyate ॥5-11-18॥

translations.english: Good couches and different kinds of seats were wellarranged in the banquet hall. The place appeared as if it was glowing witout fire.

verses.sloka: बहु प्रकारैर् विविधैर् वर सम्स्कार सम्स्कृतैः ।माम्सैः कुशल सम्युक्तैः पान भूमि गतैः पृथक् ॥५-११-१९॥
verses.transliteration: bahu prakārair vividhair vara samskāra samskṛtaiḥ ।māmsaiḥ kuśala samyuktaiḥ pāna bhūmi gataiḥ pṛthak ॥5-11-19॥

translations.english: In the banquet hall there were many types of meat arranged in a number of ways. They were cooked by experts by seasoning them with choicest ingredients.

verses.sloka: दिव्याः प्रसन्ना विविधाः सुराः कृत सुरा अपि ।शर्कर आसव माध्वीकाः पुष्प आसव फल आसवाः ॥५-११-२०॥
verses.transliteration: divyāḥ prasannā vividhāḥ surāḥ kṛta surā api ।śarkara āsava mādhvīkāḥ puṣpa āsava phala āsavāḥ ॥5-11-20॥

translations.english: There were many types of wonderful and pleasing wine extracted from sugarcane, honey , fruits and flowers. They were good even though fermented and made delicious by seasoning with aromatic spices.

verses.sloka: वास चूर्णैः च विविधैर् मृष्टाः तैः तैः पृथक् पृथक् ।सम्तता शुशुभे भूमिर् माल्यैः च बहु सम्स्थितैः ॥५-११-२१॥
verses.transliteration: vāsa cūrṇaiḥ ca vividhair mṛṣṭāḥ taiḥ taiḥ pṛthak pṛthak ।samtatā śuśubhe bhūmir mālyaiḥ ca bahu samsthitaiḥ ॥5-11-21॥

translations.english: (The banquet hall) appeared beautiful with many kinds of garlands arranged in different locations. Also there were vessels made of pure gold, crystalware and jars spread all over.

verses.sloka: हिरण्मयैः च करकैर् भाजनैः स्फाटिकैर् अपि ।जाम्बूनदमयैश्चान्याः करकैरभिवम्वृता ॥५-११-२२॥
verses.transliteration: hiraṇmayaiḥ ca karakair bhājanaiḥ sphāṭikair api ।jāmbūnadamayaiścānyāḥ karakairabhivamvṛtā ॥5-11-22॥

translations.english: (The banquet hall) appeared beautiful with many kinds of garlands arranged in different locations. Also there were vessels made of pure gold, crystalware and jars spread all over.
translations.hindi: हनुमानजी ने उन नागकन्याश्रों को देखा जिन्हें रावण बलपूर्वक हर लाया | था, किन्तु जनकनन्दिनी नहीं दिखाई पड़ीं

verses.sloka: राजतेषु च कुम्भेषु जाम्बूनदमयेषु च ।पान श्रेष्ठम् तदा भूरि कपिः तत्र ददर्श ह ॥५-११-२३॥
verses.transliteration: rājateṣu ca kumbheṣu jāmbūnadamayeṣu ca ।pāna śreṣṭham tadā bhūri kapiḥ tatra dadarśa ha ॥5-11-23॥

translations.english: Hanuman saw the best of wines in large quantities kept in silver and pure gold pots.
translations.hindi: शा शत य कट, सा ७ ताला समर» नमन लता का हाफ. 0 श्रयोदशः सगः १३५ महावाहु पवननन्दन हनुमानजी ने अन्य सुन्दरी स्त्रियों में हू ने पर भी जब जानकीजी को न देखा, तब वे दुखी हुए

verses.sloka: सो अपश्यत् शात कुम्भानि शीधोर् मणिमयानि च ।राजतानि च पूर्णानि भाजनानि महा कपिः ॥५-११-२४॥
verses.transliteration: so apaśyat śāta kumbhāni śīdhor maṇimayāni ca ।rājatāni ca pūrṇāni bhājanāni mahā kapiḥ ॥5-11-24॥

translations.english: ﻿ The great monkey saw the wine jars made of gold and silver studded with crystals and gems.
translations.hindi: सीता का पता लगाने के लिए सुग्रीव का उद्योग और श्रपना समुद्र का फाँदना व्यर्थ हुआ देख, पवननन्दन पुनः चिंतित हो गए

verses.sloka: क्वचिद् अर्ध अवशेषाणि क्वचित् पीतानि सर्वशः ।क्वचिन् न एव प्रपीतानि पानानि स ददर्श ह ॥५-११-२५॥
verses.transliteration: kvacid ardha avaśeṣāṇi kvacit pītāni sarvaśaḥ ।kvacin na eva prapītāni pānāni sa dadarśa ha ॥5-11-25॥

translations.english: He saw wine jars at one place, some fully drained, and at another place not touched at all.

verses.sloka: क्वचिद् भक्ष्यामः च विविधान् क्वचित् पानानि भागशः ।क्वचिद् अन्न अवशेषाणि पश्यन् वै विचचार ह ॥५-११-२६॥
verses.transliteration: kvacid bhakṣyāmaḥ ca vividhān kvacit pānāni bhāgaśaḥ ।kvacid anna avaśeṣāṇi paśyan vai vicacāra ha ॥5-11-26॥

translations.english: He moved about looking at different types of eatables and drinks arranged separately along with the left over food.

verses.sloka: क्वचित् प्रभिन्नैः करकैः क्वचिद् आलोडितैर् घटैः ।क्वचित् सम्पृक्त माल्यानि जलानि च फलानि च ॥५-११-२७॥
verses.transliteration: kvacit prabhinnaiḥ karakaiḥ kvacid āloḍitair ghaṭaiḥ ।kvacit sampṛkta mālyāni jalāni ca phalāni ca ॥5-11-27॥

translations.english: At some places he saw broken pots, at other places rolling pots and elsewhere flower garlands strewn and mixed up with water and fruits.

verses.sloka: शयनानि अत्र नारीणाम् शून्यानि बहुधा पुनः ।परस्परम् समाश्लिष्य काश्चित् सुप्ता वर अन्गनाः ॥५-११-२८॥
verses.transliteration: śayanāni atra nārīṇām śūnyāni bahudhā punaḥ ।parasparam samāśliṣya kāścit suptā vara anganāḥ ॥5-11-28॥

translations.english: Hanuman saw many beds some unused and some occupied by lovely women sleeping, embracing one another.

verses.sloka: काचिच् च वस्त्रम् अन्यस्या अपह्Rत्य उपगुह्य च ।उपगम्य अबला सुप्ता निद्रा बल पराजिता ॥५-११-२९॥
verses.transliteration: kācic ca vastram anyasyā apahRtya upaguhya ca ।upagamya abalā suptā nidrā bala parājitā ॥5-11-29॥

translations.english: Overcome with sleep some women pulled clothes of other women and covered their bodies with them.

verses.sloka: तासाम् उच्च्वास वातेन वस्त्रम् माल्यम् च गात्रजम् ।न अत्यर्थम् स्पन्दते चित्रम् प्राप्य मन्दम् इव अनिलम् ॥५-११-३०॥
verses.transliteration: tāsām uccvāsa vātena vastram mālyam ca gātrajam ।na atyartham spandate citram prāpya mandam iva anilam ॥5-11-30॥

translations.english: The lovely clothes and garlands on the bodies of women were moving mildly by their exhalations as if shaken by the gentle breeze.

verses.sloka: चन्दनस्य च शीतस्य शीधोर् मधु रसस्य च ।विविधस्य च माल्यस्य पुष्पस्य विविधस्य च ॥५-११-३१॥
verses.transliteration: candanasya ca śītasya śīdhor madhu rasasya ca ।vividhasya ca mālyasya puṣpasya vividhasya ca ॥5-11-31॥

translations.english: With the many scents of cool sandal, of sweetsmelling wines of diverse kinds, as well as flower garlands of several types and of incense burning in that hall, the cool wind blew spreading several fragrances all over.

verses.sloka: बहुधा मारुतः तत्र गन्धम् विविधम् उद्वहन् ।स्नानानाम् चन्दनानाम् च धूपानाम् चैव मूर्चितः ।प्रववौ सुरभिर् गन्धो विमाने पुष्पके तदा ॥५-११-३२॥
verses.transliteration: bahudhā mārutaḥ tatra gandham vividham udvahan ।snānānām candanānām ca dhūpānām caiva mūrcitaḥ ।pravavau surabhir gandho vimāne puṣpake tadā ॥5-11-32॥

translations.english: The wind wafting through the Pushpaka chariot carried the fragrance of the cool sandalpaste used in bath and the sweet smell of wines and thick smoke of fragrance spread further.

verses.sloka: श्याम अवदाताः तत्र अन्याः काश्चित् कृष्णा वर अन्गनाः ॥५-११-३३॥
verses.transliteration: śyāma avadātāḥ tatra anyāḥ kāścit kṛṣṇā vara anganāḥ ॥5-11-33॥

translations.english: There in the demons abode were women who were fair, some lovely with dark and others with golden complexion.

verses.sloka: काश्चित् कान्चन वर्ण अन्ग्यः प्रमदा राक्षस आलये ।तासाम् निद्रा वशत्वाच् च मदनेन विमूर्चितम् ॥५-११-३४॥
verses.transliteration: kāścit kāncana varṇa angyaḥ pramadā rākṣasa ālaye ।tāsām nidrā vaśatvāc ca madanena vimūrcitam ॥5-11-34॥

translations.english: Withered due to indulgence in sex they were overcome with sleep. The charm of the women was like the lotus creepers with closed lotuses .

verses.sloka: पद्मिनीनाम् प्रसुप्तानाम् रूपम् आसीद् यथैव हि ।एवम् सर्वम् अशेषेण रावण अन्तः पुरम् कपिः ॥५-११-३५॥
verses.transliteration: padminīnām prasuptānām rūpam āsīd yathaiva hi ।evam sarvam aśeṣeṇa rāvaṇa antaḥ puram kapiḥ ॥5-11-35॥

translations.english: Brilliant Hanuman ransacked the harem of Ravana but found no Janaki.

verses.sloka: ददर्श सुमहा तेजा न ददर्श च जानकीम् ।निरीक्षमाणः च ततः ताः स्त्रियः स महा कपिः ॥५-११-३६॥
verses.transliteration: dadarśa sumahā tejā na dadarśa ca jānakīm ।nirīkṣamāṇaḥ ca tataḥ tāḥ striyaḥ sa mahā kapiḥ ॥5-11-36॥

translations.english: The great monkey was very much worried as he thought he had transgressed the moral code by watching the women.

verses.sloka: जगाम महतीम् चिन्ताम् धर्म साध्वस शन्कितः ।पर दार अवरोधस्य प्रसुप्तस्य निरीक्षणम् ॥५-११-३७॥
verses.transliteration: jagāma mahatīm cintām dharma sādhvasa śankitaḥ ।para dāra avarodhasya prasuptasya nirīkṣaṇam ॥5-11-37॥

translations.english: 'Observing the wives of others in this manner in their inner chambers very much amounts to transgression of moral code by me'. ( thought he)

verses.sloka: इदम् खलु मम अत्यर्थम् धर्म लोपम् करिष्यति ।न हि मे पर दाराणाम् दृष्टिर् विषय वर्तिनी ॥५-११-३८॥
verses.transliteration: idam khalu mama atyartham dharma lopam kariṣyati ।na hi me para dārāṇām dṛṣṭir viṣaya vartinī ॥5-11-38॥

translations.english: 'I did see these wives of another, but not with a sensual mind. I have only seen them but not with foul intention'.

verses.sloka: अयम् च अत्र मया दृष्टः पर दार परिग्रहः ।तस्य प्रादुर् अभूच् चिन्ता पुनर् अन्या मनस्विनः ॥५-११-३९॥
verses.transliteration: ayam ca atra mayā dṛṣṭaḥ para dāra parigrahaḥ ।tasya prādur abhūc cintā punar anyā manasvinaḥ ॥5-11-39॥

translations.english: Another bright idea struck the highly sensible Hanuman, who had a clear vision of the task ahead-- 'I was firm and singleminded in my direction regarding the task ahead' (thought he).

verses.sloka: निश्चित एक अन्त चित्तस्य कार्य निश्चय दर्शिनी ।कामम् दृष्ट्वा मया सर्वा विश्वस्ता रावण स्त्रियः ॥५-११-४०॥
verses.transliteration: niścita eka anta cittasya kārya niścaya darśinī ।kāmam dṛṣṭvā mayā sarvā viśvastā rāvaṇa striyaḥ ॥5-11-40॥

translations.english: 'It is true I saw all the loyal wives of Ravana but without any foul desire. Indeed in my mind no passionate feeling was ever aroused'.

verses.sloka: न तु मे मनसः किम्चिद् वैकृत्यम् उपपद्यते ।मनो हि हेतुः सर्वेषाम् इन्द्रियाणाम् प्रवर्तते ॥५-११-४१॥
verses.transliteration: na tu me manasaḥ kimcid vaikṛtyam upapadyate ।mano hi hetuḥ sarveṣām indriyāṇām pravartate ॥5-11-41॥

translations.english: 'Mind propels the sense organs to do good or bad deeds. (But) my mind is firmly esatablished in righteousness'.

verses.sloka: शुभ अशुभास्व् अवस्थासु तच् च मे सुव्यवस्थितम् ।न अन्यत्र हि मया शक्या वैदेही परिमार्गितुम् ॥५-११-४२॥
verses.transliteration: śubha aśubhāsv avasthāsu tac ca me suvyavasthitam ।na anyatra hi mayā śakyā vaidehī parimārgitum ॥5-11-42॥

translations.english: 'It is not possible for me to look for Vaidehi elsewhere. During such search operations one always looks for women among women.'

verses.sloka: स्त्रियो हि स्त्रीषु द्Rश्यन्ते सदा सम्परिमार्गणे ।यस्य सत्त्वस्य या योनिः तस्याम् तत् परिमार्ग्यते ॥५-११-४३॥
verses.transliteration: striyo hi strīṣu dRśyante sadā samparimārgaṇe ।yasya sattvasya yā yoniḥ tasyām tat parimārgyate ॥5-11-43॥

translations.english: 'One has to search a creature among its own species. It is not possible to find a lost woman in the herd of female deer'.

verses.sloka: न शक्यम् प्रमदा नष्टा मृगीषु परिमार्गितुम् ।तद् इदम् मार्गितम् तावत् शुद्धेन मनसा मया ॥५-११-४४॥
verses.transliteration: na śakyam pramadā naṣṭā mṛgīṣu parimārgitum ।tad idam mārgitam tāvat śuddhena manasā mayā ॥5-11-44॥

translations.english: 'I searched all over Ravana's harem with a pure mind but I have not seen Janaki'.

verses.sloka: रावण अन्तः पुरम् सरम् दृश्यते न च जानकी ।देव गन्धर्व कन्याः च नाग कन्याः च वीर्यवान् ॥५-११-४५॥
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇa antaḥ puram saram dṛśyate na ca jānakī ।deva gandharva kanyāḥ ca nāga kanyāḥ ca vīryavān ॥5-11-45॥

translations.english: Even while valiant Hanuman was looking among the daughters of gods, gandharvas and nagas he could not find Janaki.

verses.sloka: अवेक्षमाणो हनुमान् न एव अपश्यत जानकीम् ।ताम् अपश्यन् कपिः तत्र पश्यमः च अन्या वर स्त्रियः ॥५-११-४६॥
verses.transliteration: avekṣamāṇo hanumān na eva apaśyata jānakīm ।tām apaśyan kapiḥ tatra paśyamaḥ ca anyā vara striyaḥ ॥5-11-46॥

translations.english: Heroic Hanuman, unable to find Sita among the women, moved aside and started thinking.

verses.sloka: अपक्रम्य तदा वीरः प्रध्यातुम् उपचक्रमे ।स भूयस्तु परम् श्रीमान् मारुतिर्यत्नमास्थितः ॥५-११-४७॥
verses.transliteration: apakramya tadā vīraḥ pradhyātum upacakrame ।sa bhūyastu param śrīmān mārutiryatnamāsthitaḥ ॥5-11-47॥

translations.english: Illustrious Hanuman left the banquet hall to renew his effort in search of Sita. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे एकादशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the eleventh sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
